project_type: Maven reactor (parent pom.xml; modules order-platform, inventory-service, shopflow-starter), Spring Boot 4.1.2, Java 25, Spring MVC + JPA + Flyway + Kafka + OAuth2 resource server
build_system: Maven via ./mvnw at the repo root (wrapper pinned in .mvn/wrapper); .mvn/jvm.config carries JDK flags for Error Prone; order-platform compiles with Error Prone 2.52.0 + NullAway 0.14.3 (OnlyNullMarked=true, so every package needs package-info.java with @NullMarked); inventory-service gets the same plugin block in FEAT-003
test_framework: JUnit 5 + AssertJ, @WebMvcTest, @DataJpaTest, @SpringBootTest with Testcontainers (postgres:17-alpine, apache/kafka:4.3.2, quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.8.1 through com.github.dasniko:testcontainers-keycloak 4.4.0, wiremock/wiremock:3.13.1), Awaitility, RestTestClient
test_command: ./mvnw -B -ntp verify   (module: ./mvnw -B -ntp -pl order-platform verify ; single class: ./mvnw -B -ntp -pl inventory-service -Dtest=StockControllerTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test)
verification_instructions: Docker must be running. Each FEAT verifies with its module verify, the last one with the root verify. On PowerShell write the command to a .ps1 file and redirect output to target/*.log (long shell runs can return early or garble output), then read the log and the surefire reports. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs ./mvnw -B -ntp verify with a 10-minute failure target (warn at 6): every extra Keycloak Spring context costs about 20 s, so inventory-service integration tests must share one context via an abstract base class.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell, Docker available. Never push. Worktree is c:/PUBLIC/PROJECTS/JOB PREP/dev/shop-flow/.worktrees/inventory-service-prod; relative paths land in the parent workspace, so use absolute paths. Ports: order-platform 8080, inventory 8081, Keycloak 8180, Kafka 9092, inventory Postgres 5433, WireMock stand-in also uses 8081 (cannot run with the real service). Stop all apps and containers after the e2e run. At HEAD the inventory-service has NO stock API (placeholder); the brief's 'current state' for it is wrong.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md/steering are in the coder's context. Keep order-platform conventions: records, constructor injection, javadoc on why, ProblemDetail handlers, dev-only credentials marked as dev only. Event rules (EventEnvelope javadoc): add optional fields only; never rename or remove. Update READMEs and docs/NOTES.md; docs/user-stories.md only if a story changes.
key_patterns: Outbox: OutboxEvents.add(Payload) inside the business transaction, OutboxRelay sends. Inbox: ProcessedEvents.markProcessed(consumer, eventId) in the same transaction as the work. Consumer: @RetryableTopic + @KafkaListener + @DltHandler -> DeadLetters (order-platform events/OrderEventListener). ShedLock: @Scheduled + @SchedulerLock, SchedulingConfig supplies Clock and JdbcTemplateLockProvider. Security: SecurityConfig with oauth2ResourceServer jwt, issuer-uri SHOPFLOW_ISSUER_URI default http://localhost:8180/realms/shopflow, principal-claim preferred_username, authorities-claim-expressions upper-casing realm_access roles with ROLE_ prefix. Tests: StoryTestSupport shares one context; KeycloakTestcontainersConfiguration and TestcontainersConfiguration are @TestConfiguration beans with DynamicPropertyRegistrar / @ServiceConnection. Inventory client: @HttpExchange InventoryClient built in InventoryClientConfig from RestClient.Builder; InventoryStockReservations maps 409 -> InsufficientStockException, 404 on release = released, everything else -> InventoryUnavailableException (retried).
directory_structure: order-platform/ (app, keycloak/ realm + README, http/ .http + webhook script, src/main/java/com/shopflow/order/{api,domain,events,infra,inventory,payments}); inventory-service/ (placeholder app at HEAD); shopflow-starter/ (untouched skeleton); deploy/wiremock/ (stand-in compose, stubs, wiremock.ps1); docs/ (NOTES.md, user-stories.md); load-tests/ (k6 + compare-virtual-threads.ps1); .github/workflows/ci.yml; new root compose.yaml (FEAT-001). Plan with full Digest: .agents/tasks/inventory-service-prod/plan.md in the parent workspace.
